Then repeat for user ID 67890, changing name and email to the same value as well as well. There's some confusion: "the same value as well as well"? Probably they mean also change name and email to "John" and "example@.com". So we need to call the function twice.

We should produce two calls to the function. According to guidelines, we can only output one function call at a time. But we can chain them? The instructions say: "When calling a function, do not provide additional text or explanation." Also "If you need to call multiple functions, you can do so in separate messages." So we need to send two separate messages, each containing a function call. We cannot combine them into one JSON object. So we will first call update_user_info for user_id 12345. Then after receiving response, we call again for user_id 67890.

Thus we need to produce two messages. The first message: function call with arguments: user_id=12345, update_info={name:"John", email:"example@.com"}, database="CustomerInfo". Then second message: same but user_id=67890.
